## Interview

**Q.** Why did the fund withhold $1,780.80 — dividends don't normally carry withholding?

**A.** Backup withholding — my fault. After my name change the fund's TIN records didn't match and I ignored the two notices, so they withheld the flat 24% of everything they paid me this year. It's fixed now.

**Q.** Did you sell any shares this year?

**A.** No — the box 2a amount is the fund's own December capital-gain distribution; I sold nothing, so there's no Schedule D to fill out.

**Q.** Any dependents? Could anyone claim you as a dependent? Are you blind, disabled, or a student? A U.S. citizen all year?

**A.** No to all of those, and yes — citizen all year.
